notes.title: MYTH OF MIST：LEGACY Patch About Quest and Story system 2023.09.04
notes.content:
This is a story mode and adventure related update for the game, as well as some news about our invitation to the BIC Festival in Korea. We're also participating in Steam's Strategy Games Festival Sale with a 10-hour limited time discount for those who are interested.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/a4fd7ebad1c31f111c12fb78a415b9ad3792fdac.jpg[/img]

In this update, we have adjusted the mission logic of all the routes in the fourth and fifth chapters of the game, in addition to avoiding the interruption of mission lines in certain processes, we have also relaxed some of the conditions for achieving the true ending, in the hope that it will allow players to be more free in the strategy of different routes.

At the same time, the "Story" difficulty has also been removed from the game's difficulty selection, so players can now select the Story difficulty at the beginning of the game without having to go through a round of the game. In the Story difficulty, players will be able to win the battle directly through the Quick Win feature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/9f3e6347a137ebe254955b93f36ead74d82ded5d.jpg[/img]

We believe that the fun of a game comes from the player's choices, not only in terms of the content of the game, but also in terms of how the player experiences the game. With this update, we hope that players who want to try out different storylines and options will be able to experience the game more freely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/52fd94d38b1146d7562bfa2334fac22d012faa07.jpg[/img]

Last but not least, we would like to share the news of our trip to the BIC Festival and thank the organizer again for inviting us to the festival. We met many developers from all over the world and it was a rewarding trip for us. We will continue to work hard and persevere in this path of game development!

notes.title: MYTH OF MIST：LEGACY Spring Patch
notes.content:
Welcome Back, Adventurer

Straight to the picture. Spring update is here!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/7ac3655e4f151897c6c29e4d5651b97ea2c7fa27.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/b98ad8ddc47423dc0ef5c34bd9ad4b02d4f0b0e2.png[/img]

The main update of this spring version is that all the avatars of characters, enemies and monsters in the game have been completely updated. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/54df38df50fe4b331d86b2e7140a89bffff446e6.jpg[/img]

This is a major release that took more than half a year to produce, and it is a promise to our players who have supported us from the very beginning. If you are an old friend, welcome back to see the new look of the game; if you are a new player, you are also invited to enter this fantasy world where story and strategy are interwoven.

In addition, in this update we have also adjusted some of the professions, skills, values and monster strengths, hoping to give some of the more popular professions and team combinations to play and experience.

More optimization of the game surface is also in progress, as we alwalys saying, your feedback we have received, we will do our best to let the game slowly become the way you like.


Lastly, thank you again for your support.
In a few days it will be the spring sale, if you like the content we continue to update, we hope you can leave a comment to give us some encouragement and recommend the game to your friends who like SLG and RPG.


New content.

2、Adjustment of skills and values of melee professions

Bug fixes:

notes.content:
Welcome Back, Adventurer

This is an update for the international version, mainly to solve the problem of reading coordinates and data operators in the game due to different languages. 

We have tested the windos system and regional language settings for English, Russian, French and German, which are currently the most used by non-Chinese speaking players, and should now be able to eliminate the two main issues below.

The fixes are as follows.
1、Fix the problem of black screen after starting the game for non-Chinese version.
2、Fix the problem that non-Chinese version can't continue to read the screen when entering battles, scenes and events.

There is also a situation that we are still looking for a more stable solution, that is, some international language players will be thrown into the black space after passing the prologue and some battles, resulting in the problem that they can control their characters and hear the sound of moving footsteps, but cannot do other operations.

This situation has not happened in the internal test after the update of this version, but because of the problem of different computers and national languages, if you still encounter it, please tell us again, thank you!

notes.title: Steam workshop support - for Language MOD first
notes.content:
Welcome Back, Adventurer


We’ve finally opened the workshop, this workshop is created mainly for the players who can't understand the original language of the game. By using this workshop, adventurers can edit and translate the text in the game into different languages, and share it to every player for usage. We hope that every adventurer who wants to experience the story of Myth of Mist:Legacy will no longer be limited by language.


How to create a translation mod?
Please view the readme file for details.
Path:
Steam\steamapps\common\MythofMistLegacy\MistOfMythLegacy\MythofMistLegacy_Data\StreamingAssets\Language\Mod\readme_en.pdf


Where to find the workshop?
1. Select Mist Of Myth:Legacy from the Steam Collection
2. Select Community Hub
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/72a2e3036138cb05c825d10faf40869c476589d2.jpg[/img]

3. Select Workshop
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/9757af7b12387e30b4c41d518ad0fd9f3b93cd33.jpg[/img]

4. Browse > Items
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/fab89c9d02c5ea37e16da23fa338603ba2cde6ad.jpg[/img]

5. Select the mod you would like to subscribe to
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/423bd383fc2ecec9ca269e759180a7bca223b434.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/e030926486380a352d00d2f46e28ef4df9f8f183.jpg[/img]

6. After subscribing, return to the main menu of the game and click on the MOD button.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/7d9b5224eaadf6c3e25f3dfec42756b97e5d7792.jpg[/img]

7. Go to the mod page and select the item you just subscribed to, restart the game and you're done!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/40659b51e6827d2690bc3d422778a385b76a6e39.jpg[/img]


Above, I hope to let friends who want to use the MOD have a clearer description
In addition, the team has also started to study and discuss about the mods and functions of 
other parts of the game.
We will tell you more about it later!

Lastly, I hope you enjoy the new content and updates in this major revision!
See you next time!

notes.title: English Version and Russian version 1.01 Update
notes.content:
Welcome Back, Adventurer

Thanks to your long wait, the English and Russian versions are now available!
Thanks our partners from Ukraine, we were able to complete this huge project thanks to their help.

As for the language version, this is our first translation, but it will not be our last. 

We are well aware that language is a profound subject, and translation of stories in particular is not an easy task. Therefore, after releasing this version, we will continue to devote ourselves to polishing and optimizing the translation.

The second version is currently 80% complete, and we expect to update the translation of another version by the end of this year.

At the same time, we have also opened up support for Steam Workshop mods, so that interested players can work with us to optimize the game's translation, or even support translations in other languages.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/40659b51e6827d2690bc3d422778a385b76a6e39.jpg[/img]

We are a small team of less than 6 people, and we know that the long wait is very hard on players' patience.
We hope to provide you with the next update before the end of 2022.

Lastly, we hope everyone will enjoy our game.
have a good game and see you guys next time!

notes.title: 2022 Update, new content and new level up system
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/0ff8551ef6b0f224b8ce1fa044359d6db8bebc28.png[/img]
Welcome Back, Adventurer

After the release of the game, we have continued to fix bugs and update many details in the game. This includes the UI, battle operations, joystick mapping, and various adventure and gameplay features.

In the meantime, we have been receiving a lot of suggestions and ideas from our players, so after the New Game+ mode, we are determined to put more development energy into it, hoping to satisfy the most frequently mentioned demand - the freedom to assign character attributes!

We are happy to share our works with you!
In addition to the installation of the character attribute free pointing feature, we also have more new content to offer you
This is the result of the joint efforts of you and the team, and it is also our gift to you before the end of this hard year!

Now, let's take a look at this annual update!


Major Update 1 - New level up system
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/4bc0143b14478b56f858f3da814e4cc7ff4f594e.png[/img]
Now players will no longer have randomly added attributes after upgrading, but will now have attribute points instead. Players can assign attribute points in the compilation interface, and can reset them for free by clicking the reset button. After resetting, all used points will be returned, including the points added by using props, and players will be able to assign their hero's attributes again!


Major Update 2 - Home System
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/073327d6d5ae9cd1dc427a8dff87a195267d9fc3.jpg[/img]
After passing certain chapters, players will be able to meet a mysterious visitor on their adventure. She will lead the player to her newly purchased manor and become the patron of the player's adventure. This manor will become the player's adventure base, and all the partners who join the player's team will also move in in order and give more help to the player in the future.


Major Update 3 - Trial Levels and New Sets
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/b058a324405bc8ac1661ef311061e52dd39ca865.jpg[/img]
After opening the Homestead system, different trial levels will be opened in the center of the Homestead based on the chapters that have been cleared. These levels will test the player's ability and team, and only by passing these tests set by the owner of the Homestead will the player be able to obtain the new trial equipment with powerful suits.

Please use your wisdom to pass the challenge of the master of the manor!


Other updated:
Battle levels Sleepy Worm Retreat, Desert Bandits, and Volcano Dungeon, 6 maps and 7 levels of difficulty adjustment
Various skill content and talent tree adjustments
New achievements related to the home system


Fixed:
Fixed the problem of abnormal AP deduction during battle movement.
Fixed a bug that caused the branch mission in Chapter 8 to get stuck.
Fixed the problem of incorrect AP display in battle.
Fixed the problem of broken maps of adventure world NPCs.
The problem of missing skill sound effects is fixed.
Fixed the BGM of family kitchen.
Fixed the location of the preview camera for the rescue battle in the residential area in Chapter 6.
Fixed the wrong character in Chapter 8 animation.
Fixed the collision wall of Dream World scenes.

notes.title: MYTH OF MIST：LEGACY Important update 20220403
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/95e52ecd51a913f40d9a8b8a7decf91cec89c7af.jpg[/img]

Welcome Back, Adventurer

　　Thank you so much to all the players who have supported us all the way to this point, we've heard all your suggestions and feedback. And that's why we're releasing this update. Yes, we're releasing all of the improvements we've been hoping to make to the low winding effect and the 2-weekend, and we're giving them to you in one go.

　　Let's start by talking about the wind-up. In order to increase the pace of the battle and the risk and benefit of a successful backdash, any attack from behind will now result in a burst, regardless of the opponent.

　　We have also raised the level cap for characters in the second game to LV.40 in the second game and LV.50 in the third game, in order to give players more fun in character development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/dbe204cdc5eca374fa5f4ddab077accf04002aab.jpg[/img]

　　In addition, to cater for players who want to try out different story lines quickly after the second week of the game, a new "Plot Mode" difficulty level will be added after the second week of the game. When you select this difficulty, all battles can be cleared directly by using the battle victory button to achieve the first victory condition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/c33e966f6ad41f5d2242f868141928a6b184fc38.jpg[/img]

　　We want the game to be more fun and fulfilling, so we've added an option for a storyline mode to allow multi-weekenders to move more smoothly and quickly through the different story lines and choose which battles they want to take on.

　　Finally, most of the game's nasty bugs have been fixed, thanks to your feedback and the efforts of our programming partners. If you find any other issues, please feel free to let us know via the forums.


What's New.
New difficulty level after the second week of the game
The level cap has been raised to LV.40 after the second week, and LV.50 after the third week.

Content adjustments.
Improved interface
Adjusted back wrap effect, now all back wrap attacks must cause a burst
Adjusted the number of combatants in the Battle of Bitter Resolve from 3 -> 4
Adjusted battle ？？？？ Adjusted the number of fighters from 3 to 4
Adjusted the number of combatants in the Battle Conspiracy 4 -> 5
Adjustment to the uneasy commotion of the battle Number of combatants 4->5
Adjust the battle for eternity! Number of players 4->5
Adjust the number of combatants in the battle Son of Pinocchio 4->5
Adjust the number of players in the battle for Duel! Beast of the Grey Moon 4-->5
Adjusts the number of players in the Battle Hero Tournament to 6 -> 7
Adjust the number of fighters in the Battle Warehouse's Duel 1 from 4 to 5.
Adjusted the number of fighters in the Battle Warehouse for Battle 2 from 4 -> 5

BUG FIXES.
Fixed an issue where normal attacks and skills could not be used while grounded

notes.title: Myth of Mist：Legacy spring update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/fd452526f692fcf4a9b3bbac5b43e2c29363aaa5.jpg[/img]

Welcome Back, Adventurer

　　This is the first major update to the game since its official launch, so let's get straight to the point.

　　As we said in the previous trailer, this update will see all the heroes, professions and skills being adjusted, in short, we have enhanced many of the skills that were less used or experienced by players, and we have also adjusted the AI of some of the monsters in response to this change.

　　We have also reworked some of the battle logic and calculations, so that the smoothness of the camera and calculations in battle should now be greatly improved, and there should be no significant LAGs, including on the lowest playable computers.

　　In terms of the UI, we've also added a hint of the back wrap effect and a description of the effect of normal attacks that restore MP. Oh yeah, we're already working on the suggestion that the back wrap effect isn't enough, and we expect to enhance the back wrap effect in the next version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/823d960690833ab5137119e79b53cbe0908d9423.jpg[/img]

　　In the future, the back attack effect will have a new effect that says "When you attack a target from behind, 100% of your attacks, whether skill or normal, will trigger a blast".

　　Finally, this will not be our last major update. The team is already testing the next wave of updates, which will include options to better experience multiple rounds of the storyline, second-week improvements, level cap settings, character growth optimizations and more. We want to do the best we can with the feedback we get from our players.

　　We hope you enjoy this major update and we'll see you next time.



BUG FIXES.
Fixed skill - Death Sentence attack range error
Fixed an issue with the Battle - Valkyrie of the End victory condition where knocking down Elmere did not trigger the attack.

Game content optimisation.

Optimised camera mirroring in battle
Improved the game's battle logic to enhance smoothness and performance
Significantly increased the drop rate of ancient gold, silver and copper coins


New features.
Added text description of the character facing function at the end of the round
New text description for drawing magic power through normal attacks

notes.title: "MYTH OF MIST：LEGACY" Upcoming Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/84d1e5a307509e025c2a8448e625b0e09a2c152b.jpg[/img]
Welcome Back, Adventurer

This is just a brief preview of our plans for future updates. Yes, the game is out, but our development doesn't end there. Since the launch of the game, we've received many new messages from new people, including private messages from the forums and other communities.

　　We've also been working hard on bug fixes and performance optimisations as a result of the new chapters, and we're expecting a spring update to be released next week.

　　The spring update will focus on fixing bugs, improving performance and smoothness in battle, and enhancing lesser-used weapon types, professions and skills. We will also be adjusting the difficulty of some of the levels and the challenge curve so that the overall challenge of the game is consistent as players explore different story lines.

　　Last but not least, this will not be our last update. In addition to modding tools, we are already evaluating and working on content that will take more time and development energy, including second-week enhancements, growth systems, performance details and more.

　　This is the first time we have produced a game of this scale, and we know there is still a lot to be desired. We hope that we can give back to all of you with the utmost sincerity and action.

notes.title: Myth of Mist: Legacy Officially Launched
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/b4e993b2d6aa5778438fc9a80a5ec0cddf8cd3ac.jpg[/img]

Welcome Back, Adventurer

       After months of development and adjustments, we are finally able to bring the full game to you. In this major update, in addition to a complete new story line, there are new story chapters with new heroes, monsters, equipment, joinable partners and endings. This is the last piece of the puzzle that completes our narrative, and it's all we hope to present to you.

　　Thank you for your company along the way, and we hope you will enjoy this work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/e59b3e947c9d1506ee4e7661dbd035d5f8a3c423.jpg[/img]

　　In addition, we have also made a significant update to the balance of the game. Many lesser-used weapon types have been enhanced, and the abilities of some of the weapons have been strengthened. We've also added more detail and dynamics to the map scenes, as well as enhanced the storyline and animation from previous story chapters to make the world more complete.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/3b808a36fd316ee4251d2ecd60c783ed4d26f55f.jpg[/img]

　　Finally, this will not be the last update to the game.
　　The basic content of the game has been completed, but we will continue to observe players' play and feedback, and make adjustments to the game's balance and pacing. We believe our journey is not over yet, and we look forward to you joining us to continue to bring more life to the world.

　　May Vera be with you, adventurers. See you next time.

notes.title: "MYTH OF MIST：LEGACY" PATCH_NOTE_20210813
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/1111a581211b4ed3344b4d7510d11530b6a1df31.jpg[/img]
Welcome Back, Adventurer

This is our first major update in August and the first major mechanic, balance and overall adjustment since the game was launched.

　　During this period of time, we have collected the voices of different types of players, and the team has also made and tested a number of mechanics changes internally, hoping that this major update will bring players a better gaming experience and bring "MYTH OF MIST：LEGACY" closer to the way we all want it to be.

　　So without further ado, let's get right to the point!

Major update.1: AP mechanism adjustment
　　In view of the slow pace of the early stages of the battle, we have decided to adjust the AP mechanism after comprehensive consideration. Let's start with the conclusion that the current AP mechanism can achieve short-range movement and action (attack, skill, use of props) in most cases during the turn.

　　However, the original turtle AP for the burst of position tactics will be affected, but you can achieve the original tactics through skill enhancement, attribute points and equipment. In short, we have adjusted the upper and lower limits of the AP mechanism and increased the base value of AP recovery per turn (now 7 AP recovery per turn), so that the action limit from zero is reduced.

　　Because of this, the general attacks of all weapons, professional skills, hero special skills, monster skills and AI, and all AP-related values in the game have been adjusted accordingly. This part will be left for you to experience in the game.


Major update.2: Attribute bonus description
　　This piece is more towards the update for players who want to study the value. I myself do not want the development team to take the initiative to reveal the numerical information, but the player community to learn from their own testing. But I've talked to some of my friends over the past two months, and I know that for players who like to study limit values and special combinations, it's much better to have an official version of some of the more complicated rules.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/a69f46b2cd4b582d27c57b5462f01bf0abe190f1.jpg[/img]

　　So, yes, you can now see clearly in the compiled attribute descriptions the "hidden value bonuses" for different attribute boosts, which are additional bonuses to the original attribute functions. As for the individual attributes and the in-game formula, we'll leave it to players who want to study them.


Major Update.3: Classes
　　Although the large-scale occupational balance adjustment will be after September, we have observed some of the weaker occupations and equipment sets, so this time, with the change of the AP mechanism, we also carried out the strengthening.

　　The main purpose of the profession skill is to increase the flexibility of use; the equipment strengthening is to enable the initial stage of the warrior class profession to have some starting MP, so that it can be faster to engage in combat and skill use. Detailed updates are as follows.

Occupational Skill Enhancement.
The following are the details of the equipment enhancements.
The card of doom.
Attack range: Single -> Cross
Attack distance: 3 -> 4

Card Master
Attack Range: Single -> Cross
Attack distance: 1 -> 3

Nightingale
Lamentation.
Attack Range：Single -> Cross

Ranger
Tractor Attack
Attack range: Single -> Cross

Initial equipment reinforcement.
Hunter series (hat, clothes, hands, feet)
Recruit series (hat, hands, feet)
Rangers series (hands, feet)
After the above series of new equipment to increase the initial MP ability

　　We know that the balance and difficulty of wargames are very influential, so we will be more cautious when making any balance changes. We hope to maintain the challenge and fun of the final game while making the early game experience smoother and allowing more special or interesting tactics to have their own stage.

　　I hope you will enjoy this update, and more adjustments and corrections will also be listed below.
　　So have fun, and I'll see you in time and in the Eternal City!

P.S.
Because this update affects a larger area, even including the AI, map events and skill determination have been adjusted to. Although we have tested two more weeks to ensure stability, we are still worried if something unpredictable will happen.

If there are any problems with the levels, AI or anything related to this period, please report back to us, thanks again!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/806a34e35731496762a615b845f31afb02969004.jpg[/img]

Welcome Back, Adventurer
I'm sure you've already seen the updates and additions we've made this week in July, what? You said you haven't seen it yet? Hey, my friend, don't say I'm not nice to you, I can't send you back to Asgard on the Rainbow Bridge, but I can open a link to show you what we've updated this week.


Mistborn: Legacy 07/29 Major Update and Bug Fixes
PATCH_NOTE_20210729:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1523260/view/2968420413970338756

　　OK, let's get back to the topic of this post - "Mistborn: Legacy" scheduled updates for August and September.

　　As you can see in the picture, we will continue to focus on the basic system adjustment of the game throughout August. In July, we added many new convenience features and made significant improvements to the UI and operation prompts, including the most important concerns about battle speed, viewing angles, and the determination of actions and skills.

　　The biggest and most influential adjustment of the AP mechanism is our main update in August.

　　There are already three versions of the AP adjustment plan running in the team, and all testing will be completed by the first week of August. Of course, it doesn't mean we will do the update right away, because it is a huge change that affects the game, the planning team and I will make sure the new AP mechanism is feasible before we launch it.

　　In addition, the interface and operation of the game will continue to be optimized, and we will continue to work on these changes based on feedback from players during this period. Also, since the current skill and quest system is too complicated, which makes it difficult to reproduce and fix bugs, the programming team will start to refactor part of the system in August to make the whole game more stable.

　　If all goes well, then this September we will be making balance adjustments to professions, attributes and old equipment and skills. We will also launch the first new challenge level, with new equipment, new achievements and new monsters included with the challenge level. This will be a game ending challenge that will hopefully allow everyone to experience more combat and treasure fun.


　　When writing this announcement, I realized that the game has been available for a month now. During this period of time, both the voices of support and the feedback of suggestions are a great encouragement to the development team and myself.

　　I read every comment and message myself, and think hard about how to make Mistborn: Legacy better. As a creator, I believe that honesty is one of the most important and fundamental things to the players who play our work and to ourselves.

　　Thank you, we will replace words with actions, and replace our gratitude with better content.

　　May the Vera be with you, adventurer.
　　If this journey has been a good experience for you, please let us know, whether it's a comment, a message, or even just a few words about what's not perfect in the game.

　　You know, in fact, creators like us need encouragement (smile)
　　A good comment, a recommendation, these are the biggest motivation for us to continue in the long night of liver games.

　　Lastly, I wish you all a happy game.
　　Let's see you in the city of time and eternity!

notes.title: "Myth of Mist: Legacy" BIG Update and Fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/51a5f0f061786a00f03520ac02aab04e11d59558.jpg[/img]

Welcome Back, Adventurer

The biggest update in July is here! Praise the liver of our program!

　　In addition to fixing most of the bugs that were preventing the game from working, we've also made an update to the battle AI to allow for more variation in how the AI works, and to allow it to function properly with the new skill and attack mechanics.

　　Oh, did I mention the "new skills and attack mechanics"? That's right, we got this done early, before August. Now you don't have to worry about empty big and empty fists anymore; at the same time, all the skills have been added with new enemy and me judgment mechanism, so that the players can have more intuitive choices in the battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/2f0eee0b1fedad01eb780094508fdf640339db6c.jpg[/img]

　　In addition, we also added the second view angle of the battle mode - bird top view, AP consumption tips when moving, CAST skill casting countdown and range prediction, fast return to the previous action function in the battle, and, yes, you have been talking about it since the first week, the automatic end of the round.

　　Of course, there is also the long mentioned archive function optimization, now you can type the archive name you want. The rest of the details of the interface, functions and operation updates, please go to the game to experience for yourself.

　　In August, we will continue to work on skill display and interface optimization, as well as more updates related to the game experience. We will also be reworking some of the systems to make the game more stable and reduce the bugs caused by many uncertainties, given the current debug difficulties in the skill system, quest system and event triggering system.

　　We have some big news to tell you next week. We will always respond to all suggestions, feedback, and leanings with one response, and that is to respond to all the voices of our players with practical actions and to do the best we can.

　　We will always deliver on our promises, but not with words, but with deeds.

Welcome Back, Adventurer

　　From the beginning of the game preview to now, we have received a lot of suggestions and bug reports from everyone. Today is a relatively large update, mainly to fix all the major bugs reported before 07/12 that will affect the game, some minor bugs are also fixed in this version if it's not too late.

　　In addition, we also prioritized to adjust some UI display and operation settings, hoping to make players more comfortable in operation. However, please give us more time to make some major UI/UX changes. We plan to start working on this area from next week, including the functional tips of the battlefield grid, the tips of the set effects and the tips of various functional descriptions.

　　In addition, from August, we will also start to reorganize the entire skill and combat system, including the most concerned about the empty fist, skill display uncertainty and related combat operation friendly, etc., will be our focus of development throughout August.

　　Finally, we would like to thank all of you who have supported and played our game. We are equally concerned about both positive and negative comments, and hope that through continuous updates and development, we can make the game "Myth of Mist: Legacy" better together.

notes.title: "Myth of Mist: Legacy" July upcoming update and plan
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/95dfd6bd85ac3358f05e99a64bfde9bf7ac977f9.jpg[/img]

Welcome Back, Adventurer

We received a lot of suggestions and feedback after the launch of the game on 07/01. Although we can't reply to all of you, we have read every message in the comments and forums, and the development team has also had many discussions in the past few days.

First Thing First!
Throughout July, we will focus on bug fixes, game feel improvements and information friendliness, while prioritizing system additions that can improve these three parts, such as game camera, skill and attack judgments, UI and display adjustments for major functions, etc.

From August, we will continue to make larger-scale or longer evaluation adjustments, including the AI, game content and occupational skills and other balance parts, and let you know our current planning.

July expected development focus.
Bug fixes.
1、Various S-level bug fixes that cause crashes, jamming and game can not be performed
2、Bug fixes for the judgment and displacement system caused by the handle operation
3, Various bug fixes from other players feedbacks 


Optimization and adjustment: 
1、Optimization of the presentation of the camera angle conversion during battle
2, In adventure mode: movement change from the four-way movement to eight-way movement for the operating feel
3、Information display optimization during battle 
4、Viewing battle scenes and vision operating optimization during battle
5、Battle interface shortcut key function optimization


New features and mechanisms.
1、Upgrade the character attributes to add the function of individual re-dice
2, Add the  function that battle level drops show the type of objects
3、Add the function to view the transfer certificate in the backpack
4、Add the ability to view the relevant teaching function in the battle
5、Add the speed adjustment function for battle
6、Added new battle perspective mode
7、New archive display and customization function

The list above is some of the bigger projects we are working on, and for other parts that you have feedback on, if they are minor details, we will proceed directly and announce them after the update goes live; as for the major changes, such as skill and judgment adjustments, they will not be implemented until after August, so we hope this will give you an idea of our current development status.

Lastly, if you have any ideas or suggestions, please feel free to discuss them with us on the Steam forum.

We will continue to work on the optimization and development of Mistborn: Legacy.
A new game mode and a new mainline will be added to the official version and are already in development.

May Vera be with you, adventurer. See you at Time and Eternal City.

notes.title: 《迷霧國度：傳承》新品節試玩後內容調整&BUG修正
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/72c77d893bb36debf0996a088d4716003b448a26.jpg[/img]

歡迎回來，冒險者！
Welcome Back, Adventurer

　　非常感謝大家這幾天來的試玩與體驗，我們收到了許多來自世界各地玩家的反饋和建議，當然還有BUG的回報。遊戲將於不久後與大家見面，這裡先列出我們將在下個版本中的調整項目，還有許多製作或改動規模比較大的內容，團隊正在著手進行討論與規劃，將會在未來的版本中陸續調整。

　　最後，再次感謝大家的試玩。
　　願薇拉看顧你的旅程，我們下次見！


[b]冒險模式調整：[/b]
1.調整任務、商店提示圖標。
2.調整動畫演出速度與部分動畫內容。
3.調整音樂音效。
4.部分音樂聲量調整。
5.新增下方功能提示欄的操作說明。
6.新增右鍵可以點開選單介面功能。
7.新增F為對話和互動快捷鍵。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40024787/ca6047e5580a639c1ae58f06b2bb357aef759910.jpg[/img]

[b]戰鬥模式調整：[/b]
1.新增英雄專屬技能Cut-In演出。
2.新增技能使用提示(名稱/命中率)。
3.調整部分戰鬥技能音效。
4.調整部分操作功能。
5.調整戰鬥勝利演出。
6.調整角色升級功能。
7.調整地形高低差對戰鬥所造成的影響，現在地形高低差除了技能判定外，也會影響暴擊率。

[b]系統介面調整：[/b]
1.新增套裝效果顯示。
2.新增屬性素質說明顯示。
3.調整部分技能強化說明。
4.商店介面資訊調整。

[b]任務相關調整：[/b]
1.調整第二章凱莉與宗兵衛任務線接取條件 。
2.調整部分支線接取條件。


[b]其他調整：[/b]
1.遊戲資料重構，優化整體讀取和運行效率。
2.讀取介面與讀取效率優化。
3.調整第一章農場宗兵衛的對話內容(有很多宗兵衛是正常現象，你沒有看錯)。


[b]BUG修正：[/b]
1.修正解析度設定無法套用的錯誤。
2.修正部分場景碰撞區域。
3.修正部分技能使用後無回應的錯誤。
4.修正進入部分場景無回應的錯誤。
5.修正部分道具名稱與說明錯誤。
6.修正部分怪物名稱與能力說明錯誤。
7.修正序章動畫字幕錯誤。
8.修正宗兵衛AI錯誤導致角色當機問題。
9.修正第一章夜晚住宅區奧斯華對話錯誤問題。
10.修正商店無法購買問題。
11.修正弱點攻擊、狂擊等技能強化後造成遊戲當機問題。


[b]討論中&後續調整的事項：[/b]
這裡的內容都是我們統整玩家反饋後，希望能進一步檢討並進行製作的項目，預定在未來版本中陸續更新。

1.編成介面快捷鍵功能，讓玩家能快速在編成、技能、職業等介面切換。
2.戰鬥中鏡頭視角轉換呈現。
3.冒險模式使用滑鼠移動或改為鍵盤多方位移動。
4.升級時角色屬性能夠各重骰的功能。
5.地形效果、地形相關技能與地形道具強化(平衡測試調整中)。
6.存檔系統優化，包括顯示資訊、操作反饋等等。
7.各個操作介面的音效與操作反饋強化。
8.點選新的旅程後在選擇難度前可以跳回遊戲標題的功能。
